findings.resolution: Incoming branch/jump/function entries cut backwards constant proof; bypass regression added.
All affected aliases are checked; DPCM aliases and out-of-range noise edits are refused.
A 16384-event budget spans all channels, envelopes and SFX in addition to per-stream limits.
Cycle detection includes held value; loop-into-hold regression verifies changed inherited value.
Unknown inherited initial values are refused explicitly.
Historical states keep ROM bytes and hashes; only the current decoded tree is retained.
Busy, cancelled, error, saved and download-requested states have distinct messages.
Details identify the current byte, preserving separate original source identity.
Actual APU comparison helper is explicitly included among immutable gate inputs.

limitations: Logical APU comparison is not listening or hardware acceptance.
Native ROM edits are not canonical AUDIO import.
